leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a basic in-memory cache with get and set operations
Configure cache eviction policies for time-based expiration
Apply cache-aside pattern to manage data retrieval and storage
Construct a write-through cache that synchronizes with persistent storage
Manipulate cache size limits and implement LRU eviction logic
Integrate caching into a mock API layer to reduce latency
Initialize cache warming mechanisms to preload frequently accessed data
